continuity.opening: Inside the Terrible Shark, Pinocchio follows a faint light after refusing to surrender with the Tunny.
continuity.closing: Pinocchio escapes the sleeping Shark with Geppetto on his back and begins swimming across the open sea.
continuity.next: When Pinocchio's strength fails, an old companion must help father and son reach land.

learningObjective: Retell a reunion and rescue through confession, promise, suspense, and determined action while maintaining a clear emotional arc.

beats.title: The Distant Candle
beats.purpose: Guide Pinocchio from darkness to the astonishing recognition of a familiar face.

beats.title: Father and Son
beats.purpose: Let the long-awaited reunion breathe before explanation begins.

beats.title: The Long Confession
beats.purpose: Condense Pinocchio's journey into an honest account of repeated choices and consequences.

beats.title: Two Years in the Dark
beats.purpose: Explain Geppetto's survival while making the final candle a visible deadline.

beats.title: Pinocchio's Promise
beats.purpose: Reverse the parent-child relationship as Pinocchio chooses to carry the father who carried him.

beats.title: The Open Mouth
beats.purpose: Build quiet suspense as they cross the sleeping Shark towards moonlit freedom.

beats.title: Thrown Back
beats.purpose: Turn a comic sneeze into a serious test of Pinocchio's steadiness after failure.

beats.title: Into the Moonlit Sea
beats.purpose: Complete the escape with Pinocchio physically bearing responsibility for Geppetto.
